The main takeaway from our work is that
the prefix-tree data structure and the global mining algorithm are very useful in distributed mining of maximal frequent patterns from databases on a distributed computing system.

, by using the prefix-tree data structure, the global mining phase can be implemented in parallel with very low communication cost and synchronization overhead, even when the global candidate itemset set contains a large number of long itemsets.
